input.title: Hedge Funds Dump Positions and Cut Staff as Selloff Deepens
input.summary: Hedge funds are reportedly liquidating positions and reducing headcount amid a deepening market selloff, signaling potential stress in agent-cleared customer activity and broader equity market liquidity.
evidence_quotes: Hedge Funds Dump Positions and Cut Staff as Selloff Deepens
input.notes: headline_only. Headline states hedge funds are dumping positions during a deepening selloff, which maps to both NSCC liquidity/variation margin stress (ECS-NSCC-LIQ) and GSD Agent Clearing Service stress from hedge fund deleveraging (FICC-GSD-11). No named firms, no magnitude given; certainty set to 2 as the event is described as ongoing/confirmed. Reach set to 1 (group of hedge funds) rather than 2 as no specific major participant is named and market-wide impact is not explicitly stated. Effect date set to announced_date per notes convention.
